scenes.line1: Can you build for keyboard users?
scenes.say: Ever tried using a site with just the keyboard? How do you make sure every user can navigate and interact without a mouse?

scenes.label: Keyboard
scenes.sub: All interactive elements must be reachable by keyboard.
scenes.say: Keyboard accessibility means every button, link, and input should be usable with just the keyboard.
When a modal opens, move focus to it. When it closes, send focus back to the trigger. For custom widgets, keep the focus order logical.
To handle modals, set a tabindex of minus one and call focus on the modal. When closing, return focus to the element that opened it.

scenes.question: How do you test keyboard navigation?
scenes.right: Tab through the interface manually. Check that focus indicators are visible and order makes sense.
scenes.say: Don't rely only on automated tools. Always test keyboard navigation by tabbing through your interface yourself.
